svg.aria-label: Scoured Siphon plan and interpretive geological profiles
svg.title: The Scoured Siphon | Plan and interpretive cave sections
svg.text: ORIGINAL CAVE GEOMORPH / PLAN + INTERPRETIVE PROFILES / STUDY 01

g.text: A–A intersects the one-cell stream crossing and bridge. B–B follows the raised gallery to its eastern ramp.

svg.text: Plan traces, flooded cell, bridge and gallery descent are derived from the same canonical geometry as the modular tile.
Ceiling silhouettes, water depth, clearances and vertical scaling are illustrative; no measured cave survey or structural assessment.
